name: stride-pace-calculator
description: Running pace, race equivalents, and VDOT training pace calculator

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && cpy LICENSE dist
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:build && npm run export && npm run test:export
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests vite.config.js package.json tsconfig.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests vite.config.js package.json tsconfig.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md .github/workflows
scripts.export: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode portable && cpy portable/index.html ../outputs --rename=running-pace-calculator.html
